# NOK Social - Digital Marketing Infrastructure & NOK OS

> NOK Social provides end-to-end digital marketing infrastructure, content growth engines, and NOK OS management tools for high-performing brands in Ghana and West Africa.

## Overview & Core Platform Capabilities

NOK Social empowers small and medium enterprises, boutique fashion brands, craft artisans, and service providers with data-driven social media growth strategies, high-converting sales funnel architectures, and brand management operating software.

## Key Public Resources

- [NOK Social Homepage](https://nok-os.web.app/home): Overview of our 5-tier digital growth infrastructure packages, strategic positioning frameworks, and client portfolio.
- [NOK Social Growth Blog](https://nok-os.web.app/blog): In-depth tactical guides on sales funnels, email sequences, landing page optimization, and West African social commerce.
- [Instagram Health Check Tool](https://nok-os.web.app/ighealthcheck): Automated profile audit and engagement benchmarking utility tailored for Ghanaian businesses.
- [Free Resources](https://nok-os.web.app/resources): Free tools and templates for growing brands — lead trackers, audit checklists, and other resources.

## Service Tiers
1. Brand Foundation (one-time): Audience profiles, brand voice, and visual identity — the starting point for every engagement.
2. Digital Presence Setup (one-time): Get found and get orderable — Google, Instagram/Facebook Shop, and Mobile Money order flow.
3. Growth Retainer (monthly): Analytics-led content and community management, month over month.
4. Campaign Package (per campaign): Focused awareness pushes, backed by data.
5. Custom Infrastructure Build (project-based): Bespoke systems for brands that have outgrown manual workflows, scoped individually.
